notes:
Background:
- Mid-market subscription billing platform (SaaS) focused on SMB customers; heavy Stripe + Zuora back-end integrations.
- Primary objective: accelerate first-response and reduce manual touch for billing disputes and plan changes.

Requirements summary (from product + platform leads):
- Workload: agent-style support assistant that can call internal billing tools (charges/refunds/subscriptions) and return structured JSON for Zendesk ticket creation.
- Latency SLO: end-to-end agent reply p95 target ~1s for single-step flows; prefer <500ms token latency for streaming chunks.
- Throughput: steady-state 50 concurrent agents with peaks up to 250 during renewals events.
- Features: streaming, first-token latency, function/tool calling, deterministic JSON outputs (schema validation), model fallback for availability.
- Security: must pass SOC2 questionnaire, SSO (SAML), KMS integration for key management, audit logs retained 1 year, EU data residency for EU customers.

POC notes / findings:
- Hosted API POC (sandbox) shows good developer velocity. Function-calling pattern works for Stripe refund flow: webhook -> function call -> structured JSON returned for Zendesk. Example JSON validated with JSON schema 1.
- Observed p95 tail spikes when tool calls invoked third-party Zuora API (latency dominated by third-party). SE proposed asynchronous tool-calling pattern and streaming partial chunks back to UI to keep perceived latency low.
- SE suggested prefix caching for common customer queries to reduce tokens and cost on hosted.
- Product team wants deterministic structured outputs — requested Redwood support for forced JSON-only response mode + eval hooks.

Commercial / procurement:
- Starting with Hosted API to iterate quickly; will evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation once monthly token volume > ~1.5M tokens.
- Main blocker: confirm Dedicated pricing bands for burst capacity and whether committed spend can be calibrated to seasonal cycles.

Quotes / direct customer language:
- "We need the assistant to create refund actions exactly in JSON with no extra commentary — this is non-negotiable."
- "If streaming can make the agent feel instant, we can tolerate some backend latency for tool calls."

Next steps (short):
- Aisha to push updated SOC2 questionnaire answers to shared Drive doc (SEC-4410).
- SE (Marco) to trial async tool-calling pattern in POC and measure end-to-end p95 with simulated Zuora delays.
- AE to provide Dedicated price punchlist and a capped-burst proposal by 2024-11-08.
- Schedule canary pilot (10 seats) on Hosted API + logging enabled to validate audit trails and JSON output stability.
